release_positioning: Air-gapped Splunk SOC copilot with isolated Conversation, SPL Builder, Investigation and Triage agents sharing one live telemetry-intelligence service and deterministic read-only controls.
core_principle: Models interpret and explain. The deterministic control plane routes. Splunk establishes deployment facts. Agent-specific contracts enforce safety, evidence and auditability.
capabilities: SOC Conversation Agent for cybersecurity and Splunk concepts
Conversation prompt isolation from Investigation, Triage and SPL Builder transcripts
Deterministic Conversation response validation with bounded clean-context repair
Exact named-concept and acronym fidelity validation
Deep framework explanations using the configured local reasoning model
Source-attributed offline reference grounding for curated public security frameworks
Deterministic cited fallback when a grounded local-model answer times out or fails its response contract
Grounded same-agent follow-up continuity without adjacent-framework substitution
SPL Builder Agent producing portable generic SPL and deployment-qualified SPL
Deterministic SPL Builder refinement contract for analyst-supplied windows, thresholds, distinct-count metrics and grouping concepts
Parent Builder source continuity with bounded revalidation before unrelated source candidates
Deterministic lexical corroboration for every required aggregation field binding
Investigation Agent executing bounded evidence-first read-only Splunk searches
Triage Agent returning evidence-linked verdict, confidence, gaps and next action
Evidence Deliverable Agent for deterministic Detection Candidate, RBA/ERS, TDIR and SOAR drafts from the current structured result
Structured evidence handoff from Investigation through Triage and chained post-investigation deliverables
Deterministic route precedence for extended SPL Builder wording, builder refinements, generated-SPL review and destructive-action blocking
Row-preserving investigation summaries with qualification/execution consistency checks
Field-level execution presence and fully-bound event continuity controls
Shared Telemetry Intelligence service for live catalogue, source profiles, field observations and cache freshness
Deterministic routing without a generative-model dependency
Read-only SPL validation and execution controls
Explicit SPL states: proposed, source-qualified, schema-qualified, data-validated and result-validated
Analyst-supplied source constraints receive first validation priority
Local-model outage isolation between agents
Conversation history and investigation workspace
Transactional compile-first deployment and automatic rollback
Audit logging with redaction and no full prompt capture by default
Sanitized GitHub source bundle with a release-blocking publication audit
product_invariants: No customer index, sourcetype, source, field, entity, value, event ID or threshold is embedded in the runtime
Routing never depends on a local generative model
Standalone SOC questions never inherit Investigation, Triage or SPL Builder response text
Conversation output cannot claim live Splunk execution, evidence, verdicts or customer-specific SPL
A named framework or acronym cannot be silently substituted with an adjacent concept
Curated reference cards contain public framework facts and citations only; they never contain customer telemetry mappings
A locally grounded framework answer must preserve its required authoritative phrases and cite its bundled sources
A grounded response receives at most one bounded model attempt before deterministic cited fallback
Explicit Detection Candidate, RBA/ERS, TDIR and SOAR requests never fall through to Conversation or Investigation
Post-investigation deliverables run no new Splunk search and execute no operational action
Missing risk objects or eligible evidence produce no risk score
Destructive or write-capable requests are blocked before an execution-capable agent is selected
Deep conceptual answers must define the exact subject, cover structure, adjacent concepts, SOC use, Splunk application and limitations
BUILD_SPL never executes the final generated SPL unless the analyst explicitly changes to an execution workflow
A Builder follow-up cannot drop or reinterpret an analyst-supplied aggregation window, comparison operator, numeric threshold or grouping concept
Workflow language such as build, portable, deployment-qualified, validation and execute cannot become a behavioural SPL filter
Embedding similarity alone cannot schema-qualify an aggregation measurement or grouping field
A Builder refinement revalidates its parent deployment source first without treating it as an analyst-supplied constraint
SPL semantic planning and SPL compilation are separate stages
The SPL Builder does not require attack events to exist before declaring telemetry schema capable
Investigation conclusions require returned Splunk evidence or explicit abstention
Connected release acceptance requires positive live event evidence to survive investigation execution and enter Triage
Positive event volume cannot satisfy acceptance when a required execution field is unpopulated
Triage definitive verdicts require returned evidence identifiers
Event volume and entity presence alone cannot create maliciousness or risk
All executable SPL passes the deterministic read-only validator
Operational actions remain human-approved and outside the read-only runtime
A failure in one agent does not disable deterministic inventory, safety or routing
Source compilation completes before active runtime replacement
Failed deployment validation restores the complete previous runtime

agent_contracts.conversation: Standalone conceptual questions use isolated prompts; named concepts require exact-subject fidelity; curated public frameworks use source-attributed local reference cards and deterministic cited fallback; only referential follow-ups receive same-agent context; no live Splunk query, operational verdict or evidence claim is permitted.
agent_contracts.spl_builder: LLM semantic intent plus deterministic generic and deployment-qualified compilation; analyst-supplied aggregation refinements are extracted and compiled deterministically; the parent source is revalidated first; required aggregation bindings need deterministic lexical corroboration beyond embedding similarity; workflow language is excluded from behaviour filters; final SPL is not executed.
agent_contracts.investigation: Live catalogue discovery, observed-schema qualification, safe bounded execution and evidence-linked synthesis.
agent_contracts.triage: Finding or investigation evidence to verdict, confidence, reasoning under 50 words, gaps and next action.
agent_contracts.deliverable: Current structured evidence to deterministic Detection Candidate, RBA/ERS, TDIR or SOAR analyst-review drafts; no new Splunk query, writeback or operational execution.

safety_boundaries: No automatic containment or SOAR execution
No malware payload or exploit generation
